b. Tools: The following tools can be used for firmware analysis:

i. IDA Pro: This is a graphical disassembler and debugger that can be used to analyze firmware code.

ii. Ghidra: This is an open-source reverse engineering tool that can be used to analyze firmware code.

iii. Volatility: This is a framework for extracting memory contents from volatile processes. It can be used to analyze the memory contents of an IoT device.

c. Techniques: The following techniques can be used for firmware analysis:

i. Code Review: This involves examining the code to identify potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses. This can be done manually or using automated tools.
